note: A shaded loop under hardwoods off TN-30, back from Parksville Lake; a few sites lie along a small stream. The tent and group camp is across the highway. Water is at hydrants, not at the sites. --Claude
summary: Cherokee NF RV campground confirmed: 17 RV sites (16 records incl. a double), 30 A at every site, no water/sewer at sites, gravel back-ins 32-122 ft; $20 ($40 double); open 02-24..01-24 on rec.gov; bathhouse with showers, hydrants, dump. Not waterfront kept. Status: Ocoee flood alert suspends FS access to Parksville Lake but does not list this campground, which is open on the FS page and booking on rec.gov.

Parksville Lake RV Campground is not in the affected list, the FS page still says 'Site Open', and rec.gov shows reservations through November 2026. A small creek under canopy at most; no upgrade. Parksville Lake is not visible from the loop.
